name: Sacrificial Jade
passiveDesc: When not on the field for more than 5s, Max HP will be increased by 32%/40%/48%/56%/64% and Elemental Mastery will be increased by 40/50/60/70/80. These effects will be canceled after the wielder has been on the field for 10s.

effects.label: Jade Circulation: after more than 5s off-field until 10s on-field

modifiers.label: Max HP bonus while Jade Circulation is active
Elemental Mastery while Jade Circulation is active
